# 1\. Introduction

BBAS is APCRDAG«÷s online system for building permission in the Amaravati Capital Region\. An LTP prepares the application, attaches the BIM / drawing files, pays fees where required, and tracks the file until a Building Permit Order is issued\. After approval, the same login is used for commencement, work\-start notification, change of LTP, and occupancy\.

__Who__

__What they do in BBAS__

Citizen

Pay fees and search application status without a full LTP login\.

Developer / TPA

Register, renew, give consent, and view registered lists\.

LTP

Register / renew the licence, then submit and manage building permission files\.

APCRDA officers

Scrutiny, objections, shortfall, show\-cause, and issue of proceedings\.

__Note: __Fields marked with a red asterisk \(\*\) are mandatory\. Save each tab with Save & Continue before moving on\.

# 2\. Portal access and login

## 2\.1 Open the BBAS home page

1. 1\. In a browser, go to __https://bbas\.ap\.gov\.in__ \(page: Default\.aspx\)\.
2. 2\. Confirm the header shows __BIM Based Building Permit System__ under APCRDA\.
3. 3\. Use __Home__, __Dashboard__, __Downloads__, or __Login__ from the top bar\.

Figure 2\.1 G«ˆ BBAS home page \(bbas\.ap\.gov\.in/Default\.aspx\)

## 2\.2 Downloads \(orders, manuals, plugin\)

1. 1\. Click __Downloads__ on the top menu\.
2. 2\. Under __Documents__, open Govt orders, Amaravati Zoning Plan and Regulations, Qualification of Licensed Technical Personnel, or the BIM Model Builder Plugin\.
3. 3\. Under __Help manuals__, open How to Apply, BIM Modeling Help Manual, or the BIM Modeling Guide video before you start a new file\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 2\.2 G«ˆ Downloads menu: documents and help manuals

## 2\.3 Login to BIMDCR \(LTP / officer login\)

1. 1\. Click __Login__\. The BIMDCR login page opens \(BPAMSClient/login\.aspx\)\.
2. 2\. Enter __Username__ and __Password__\.
3. 3\. Type the captcha shown in the image\. Use the refresh icon if it is unreadable, or the speaker icon for audio captcha\.
4. 4\. Click __Login__\.
5. 5\. If you forgot the password, use __Forgot password__ on this page\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 2\.3 G«ˆ BIMDCR login: username, password, captcha, Login

__Important: __Do not share your LTP credentials\. The header after login shows your name, last login, role \(for example Structural Engineer\), and licence validity date\.

# 3\. Public dashboard

Anyone can open __Dashboard__ from the home page to see aggregate Pre Proceeding / Post Proceeding statistics\. This is a read\-only public view, not your personal file list\.

1. 1\. Click __Dashboard__\.
2. 2\. Select __Pre Proceeding__ or __Post proceeding__\.
3. 3\. Use the __Abstract__ tab for charts, or __Application\(s\)__ for the list view\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 3\.1 G«ˆ Pre Proceeding abstract: received, scrutiny, documents, payment, proceeding issued

Typical Pre Proceeding stages shown on the abstract:

__Stage__

__Meaning__

Total Received

Applications that have entered the system\.

Scrutiny Submitted / Failed

Automated / technical scrutiny result\.

Documents Upload

File is waiting for remaining documents\.

Payment Pending

Fee memo is generated but not fully paid\.

Proceeding Issued

Building permit proceeding has been issued\.

Proceeding Cancelled

Issued proceeding was cancelled\.

# 5\. LTP portal overview \(after login\)

After a successful login, the LTP workspace \(SWC Admin\) opens\. The left sidebar is the module list\. The header shows your name, last login, role, and licence validity \(example: Structural Engineer, valid to 30\-03\-2027\)\.

__Sidebar module__

__When you use it__

Application Submission

Create a draft and send it to scrutiny\.

Application Status

Track review, objections, approval, and issued proceeding\.

Proceeding Status

Handle verified files, shortfall, and show\-cause\.

Commencement Certificate

See CC issued files and notify work start\.

Change Of LTP

Change the licensed technical person on a file\.

Occupancy

Intimate completion and track occupancy applications\.

Header icons on every screen: __Notifications__, __Activities__, __Help__, and __User__ \(profile / logout\)\.

__Tip: __List screens share the same tools: keyword search, Filter / Find / Clear, column filters, refresh, and Excel export\. The footer shows Total Proposal\(s\) \.

# 6\. Module: Application Submission

This is where a new building permission file is created\. Menu path: __Application Submission GÂ∆ Draft Application__ or __Submitted Applications__\.

## 6\.1 Draft Application G«ˆ start and General Information

1. 1\. Open __Application Submission GÂ∆ Draft Application__\.
2. 2\. A temporary application number is allotted \(example: Temp/1168/0014/BP/2025\)\. Status is __Draft Mode__\. Risk category is shown \(example: Low\)\.
3. 3\. Stay on tab __Application Form GÂ∆ General Information__\.
4. 4\. Fill Case Type \(New\), Permission Type \(Building Permission\), Nature of Permission \(General\)\.
5. 5\. Select Application Type: Private / Govt land / CRDA land\.
6. 6\. Choose LPS Layout or Non\-LPS\. Use __Change Plot__ if the plot must be switched\.
7. 7\. Select District, Mandal, LPS Village, Gram panchayat, then Township, Sector, Colony as applicable\.
8. 8\. Enter Nature of Site, Block No\., Survey No / D\.No / R\.S\.No, Plot No\., Land Use Zone, Zoning District, Proposed Use, Proposed Activity, Road/Street, and Building Height\.
9. 9\. Click __Save & Continue__\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 6\.1 G«ˆ Draft Application: General Information \(case type, LPS, location\)

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 6\.2 G«ˆ General Information continued: site identifiers, zone, proposed use, height

## 6\.2 Applicant Information

1. 1\. Open __Applicant Information__\.
2. 2\. Check __Licensed Technical PersonnelG«÷s Information__ \(pre\-filled from your login: type, name, licence number, mobile, validity, email, Aadhaar\)\.
3. 3\. Under ApplicantG«÷s Information, choose Usage Purpose: Self Use or Selling\.
4. 4\. Enter Owner Name, Door / Flat No\., Road/Street, City, District, PinCode, Email, Mobile, and Aadhaar\.
5. 5\. Confirm the Structural Engineer name in the dropdown and the licence validity date\.
6. 6\. Click __Save & Continue__\.

## 6\.3 Plot Details

1. 1\. Open __Plot Details__\.
2. 2\. Under Proposed Construction, enter Proposed Plot Area \(sq\. mtr\.\) and Plot Structure\. Answer Compound Wall and TDR \(Yes/No\)\.
3. 3\. Under Site Details, set nearby religious structures, aerodrome, water bodies / railways / HT lines, market value \(Rs per sq\. yard\), and whether the site abuts the IRR\.
4. 4\. Under Schedule of Boundaries, set North, South, West, and East \(Plot / Road / Others\) with plot numbers or road widths\.
5. 5\. Click __Save & Continue__\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 6\.5 G«ˆ Plot Details: proposed construction, site details, schedule of boundaries

## 6\.4 Application Checklist

Answer every Yes/No item\. These answers drive NOC needs and risk category \(height, zoning, monuments, railway buffer, built\-up area, and similar rules\)\.

1. 1\. Open __Application Checklist__\.
2. 2\. For each row, select __Yes__ or __No__ and add a Remark if needed\.
3. 3\. Typical checks include height greater than 10 m / 15 m \(commercial\) / 18 m \(residential or group housing\), monument buffer 100G«Ù200 m, railway 30 m, built\-up area above 20,000 sq\. m\.
4. 4\. Click __Save & Continue__\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 6\.6 G«ˆ Application Checklist: regulatory Yes/No questions

## 6\.5 Document Checklist

1. 1\. Open __Document Checklist__\. Use __Primary__ first, then __Additional__ if shown\.
2. 2\. For each required document, click __Attach Files__\.

__\#__

3

Attested Land Pooling Ownership Certificate issued by APCRDA \(or equivalent\)

4

Notarised Owner and Builder/Developer affidavit on sanctioned\-plan compliance

5

Certification of appointment to New LTP \(when applicable\)

Click a document name later to view the attachment or remarks\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 6\.7 G«ˆ Document Checklist \(Primary\) with Attach Files on each row

# 7\. Module: Application Status

Menu path: __Application Status__\. Use this module after the file has left your draft tray\. Each sub\-menu is a queue\.

__Sub\-menu__

__What you do__

Review Proceeding

Open files that are under official review\.

Objected Files

Correct scrutiny / document issues and resubmit\.

Approved Files

Open approved files; view letter, NOCs, reports\.

Proceeding Issued

See files for which the proceeding has been issued\.

## 7\.1 Review Proceeding

1. 1\. Open __Application Status GÂ∆ Review Proceeding__\.
2. 2\. Use search / column filters if the list is long\.
3. 3\. Click the Application No\. to open the application in read or limited\-edit mode\.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Figure 7\.1 G«ˆ Review Proceeding queue with Permission Type filter

## 7\.2 Objected Files G«ˆ find the file

1. 1\. Open __Application Status GÂ∆ Objected Files__\.
2. 2\. Note Status \(example: __Scrutiny Can Not Done__ in red\)\.

## 7\.3 Objected Files G«ˆ correct and resubmit

The file reopens in __Draft Mode__ so you can edit\. Extra buttons appear: __Proposal Flow__, __Action__, __Reports__, __Back__\.

1. 1\. Walk the same tabs as a new draft: General Information, Applicant Information, Plot Details, Application Checklist, Document Checklist, Others\.
2. 2\. Fix the objected data \(plot, height, checklist answers, missing attachments\)\.
3. 3\. Re\-attach or replace the BIM \.rvt if the model was the cause\.
4. 4\. Check Payments if a new memo was raised\.
5. 5\. Use __Action__ / __Send to Scrutiny__ \(as available on that screen\) to return the file to APCRDA\.
6. 6\. Use __Proposal Flow__ to see where the file sat in the office chain\.

# 12\. Common actions on every list and file

__Control__

__What it does__

Enter keywords to search for

Finds a Application No\., owner name, or other text on the current list\.

Filter / Find / Clear

Applies, runs, or resets list filters\.

Column filter icons

Filter Permission Type, Status, or Case Type\.

Excel icon

Exports the current list\.

Save & Continue

Saves the current form tab and moves forward\.

Send to Scrutiny

Submits a completed draft for official scrutiny\.

Proposal Flow

Shows the office workflow path of the file\.

Action

Opens allowed workflow actions \(objected / draft files\)\.

Reports

Opens generated reports for the file\.

Back

Returns to the previous list\.

Drawing plan / Scrutiny Report / Proceeding Letter

Opens those documents from commencement / issued screens\.

__Important: __If a form tab shows G«£OOPS\! The page you've requested is not available at this time,G«• use Back and retry, or open the same file from another queue \(Approved Files vs Verified\)\. This was seen on Applicant Information for some verified files\.

# 13\. End\-to\-end lifecycle \(LTP view\)

1. __1\. Register / renew LTP__ on the public LTP tile; then __Login__\.
2. __2\. Application Submission GÂ∆ Draft Application__: fill form tabs, attach \.rvt / \.dwg and documents, then __Send to Scrutiny__\.
3. 3\. Watch __Submitted Applications__ and __Application Status GÂ∆ Review Proceeding__\.
4. 4\. If returned: __Objected Files__ GÂ∆ correct GÂ∆ resubmit\.
5. 5\. Pay fee memos on the __Payments__ tab or via __Citizen Service GÂ∆ Pay your fees__\.
6. 6\. When approved: __Approved Files__ / __Proceeding Issued__ GÂ∆ download Letter \(BPO\) and complete __Apply for NOCs__\.
7. 7\. Handle __Proceeding Status__ \(Verified, Shortfall, Show Cause\) until the proceeding is clean\.
8. __8\. Commencement Certificate__: after CC, open __Work Initiated__ and __Notify__ the commencement date\.
9. 9\. Use __Change Of LTP__ only if the professional on the file must change\.
10. 10\. On completion: __Occupancy GÂ∆ INTIMATE COMPLETION__, then track __Submitted Application__\.
